extracted.intended_audience: academic researchers, university faculty, graduate and undergraduate students, research administrators, and research institutions interested in collaboration or funding from Google Research
extracted.subtask_description: Information about Google Research's programs, funding, mentorship, and engagement opportunities for students, faculty, and institutions; useful for prospective applicants and institutional partners evaluating fit and opportunities. Emphasizes research alignment, inclusion, societal impact, and community engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for work pushing boundaries of AI and computer science
rubrics_metrics.description: Google supports academic and research institutions to push the boundaries of AI and computer science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs leverage Google’s research initiatives to provide funding, mentorship, and engagement opportunities so the research community can innovate faster to solve the world’s biggest problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of funding, mentorship, and engagement opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs provide funding, mentorship, and engagement opportunities to students, faculty, and institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offers fellowships, scholarships, internships, mentorship sessions, and other student engagement opportunities; faculty programs provide funding and enable meaningful engagements with Google researchers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Student programs (fellowships/scholarships/internships)
rubrics_metrics.description: Google offers fellowships, scholarships, internships and other student engagement opportunities to support the next generation of researchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Student experience highlights include one-on-one mentorship, feedback on research and career pathways, and support for grad school and industry research preparation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Faculty research programs (global funding and support)
rubrics_metrics.description: Global faculty programs provide funding and support to advance academic research and enable meaningful engagements with Google researchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs can include awards such as the Award for Inclusion Research (AIR) and are intended to build long-term research partnerships and capacity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for inclusion, diversity, and capacity-building
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs and partnerships aim to increase awareness, interest, and research capacity among underrepresented groups and institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include partnerships with organizations like CAHSI to address underrepresentation (e.g., Hispanic student PhD enrollment gaps) and programs focused on Indigenous students; guidance implies prioritizing projects that build capacity and address equity gaps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with core areas relevant to Google products and services
rubrics_metrics.description: Featured collaborations focus on innovative research in core areas relevant to Google’s products and services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintaining strong ties with students, faculty, labs, and institutions worldwide; projects that align with Google-relevant technical areas are highlighted for collaboration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for research creating positive societal impact and Trust & Safety
rubrics_metrics.description: Google supports academics working to create positive societal impact with technology, including Trust & Safety research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: T&S Research collaborates across disciplines and with affected populations to mitigate tech risks and drive positive outcomes; in 2023 Google provided unrestricted grants for diverse Trust & Safety research efforts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engagement through conferences and events
rubrics_metrics.description: Google participates in and supports conferences and events to contribute to and learn from scientific community conversations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs include outreach and presence at scientific meetings as a mechanism for engagement, knowledge exchange, and community building.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognition through past programs and awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Google has historically recognized and supported world-class faculty, scholars, and organizations with funding through various programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Past programs and recipients are documented as examples of supported excellence; prospective applicants can explore historical awards and recipients to understand program focus and impact.
